verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an in-product AI Game Agent that takes plain-language requests, can suggest random game ideas ('Surprise Me'), and acts on a user's game project through an MCP server with 40+ editor tools. That is AI assistance over the user's own project, but it is generative and action-oriented rather than analysis that surfaces insights from user data. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of the user's project or game data, proactive suggestions derived from that data, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
